name: Comparator Inspector
description:
Inspect the current comparator signal (0–15) of chests and other readable blocks.

Point at a block or show nearby signals within a configurable radius. Independently customize visibility, colors, opacity and text size for above-block labels and the info panel. Adjust label height above blocks too. Enable comparator outputs separately to show actual circuit outputs, including compare/subtract mode and side inputs.

Start with /ci or the configuration button. Nearby radius: 1–32 blocks. Label height: 0.00–3.00 blocks.

Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric. Requires Fabric API. Multiplayer needs the mod on both server and client. Reads real server values in loaded chunks only.
